name: Löyly
priceLabel: €29 / 2h · extra hour €12 · towel, seat cover, shampoo and soap included
sauna: A smoke sauna (18 m²) and a wood-heated sauna (22 m²), both single-fired, about 20 bathers each
pool: The sea, from the terrace, all year if the weather allows
flag: The saunas are mixed, so swimwear is required (rental €8). Booking ahead is recommended.

stove.note: A smoke sauna and a wood-heated sauna, both single-fired

name: Allas Sea Pool
priceLabel: €19 / 2h Mon–Thu and Fri until 14:00 · €24 from Fri 14:00, at weekends and on holidays · students, pensioners, conscripts and unemployed €14 / €18 · 10 visits €158
sauna: Five saunas: the Kulmasauna at 90°C, the Maisemasauna at 80°C with a sea view, and three floating saunas at 70°C (mixed, women's and men's)
pool: A heated 25 m pool at 27°C and a seawater pool, both open all year; a children's pool in summer
hours: Mon–Fri 06:30–21:00 · Sat–Sun 08:00–21:00; ticket sales end an hour before closing, swimming and sauna 20 minutes before
bestFor: Swim in the harbour, then a sauna
flag: Swimwear is required in the mixed saunas, and a towel is not included (rental €8.90). The floating saunas take turns shut for upkeep until 12:00: the mixed one on Mondays, the men's on Tuesdays, the women's on Wednesdays.
aufgussNote: You throw your own water on the stones; in the Maisemasauna a button releases the löyly instead
heatSrc: read off the venue's own page, 25 Nov 2026

name: Kotiharjun sauna
priceLabel: €16 · reduced €13 · 10 visits €140 · 5 visits €75 · towel €4 · full wash €15 (Thu & Sat)
sauna: Helsinki's last wood-heated neighbourhood sauna: separate men's and women's public saunas with single-fired stoves, plus an electric sauna for hire
pool: No pool; you cool off on the pavement out front
flag: No booking for the public saunas. The men's sauna is used naked; you may wrap a towel around you.
aufgussNote: Bathers throw the water, from a tap on the stove; ask the others first, and by old rule whoever sits in the hottest spot decides

stove.note: The public saunas are wood-heated; the sauna for hire is electric

name: Uusi Sauna
priceLabel: €18, seat cover included · towel €5 · bathrobe €8 · no booking needed
sauna: Separate men's and women's saunas heated with wood pellets, about 20 bathers each, and an electric mixed sauna for 10 to 15
pool: No pool; a terrace for cooling off
bestFor: A public sauna with a bar

stove.note: The men's and women's saunas burn wood pellets; the mixed sauna is electric

name: Kulttuurisauna
sauna: Wood- and pellet-heated, one single-fired mass stove; Friday evenings are silent
pool: The sea, and an ice hole in winter
hours: Evenings Wed–Sun 16:00–20:00, booked ahead, last entry 18:45 · mornings Fri–Sun 08:00–11:30, walk in, last entry 10:30 · closed Mon & Tue
bestFor: A quiet sauna on the water
flag: No groups: more than two people count as one and are not admitted. Bring your own towel, a seat towel and a water bottle.

stove.note: Wood and pellets in one single-fired mass stove

name: Sompasauna
sauna: Run by volunteers with no staff: whoever comes heats it. Mixed, and clothing is up to you
bestFor: A free sauna you heat yourself
flag: No running water, showers or changing rooms. Bring drinking water, a towel and a padlock for the lockers.
aufgussNote: Nobody works there: whoever comes heats the sauna themselves

name: Sauna Hermanni
priceLabel: €14 · reduced €10 · under 15 free · 10 visits €110 · 5 visits €60 · towel €4
sauna: Separate men's (30 bathers) and women's (20) sides, heated with IKI stoves; a public sauna since the 1950s
hours: Mon, Wed–Fri 15:00–20:00 · Sat 14:00–18:00, bathe for an hour after · closed Tue & Sun

stove.note: New IKI stoves on both sides; its site does not say what they burn

name: Lapinlahden Lähteen sauna
priceLabel: €12 / 2h · students, unemployed and pensioners €6 · towel €5 · seat cover €2.50
sauna: The 1880s sauna building of the old Lapinlahti hospital, by their account the oldest working sauna in Helsinki open to the public; room for 10, one shared changing room, a volunteer sauna host on duty
pool: No pool; the shore is under 100 m away
hours: Public turns on set dates, listed month by month on their page: mixed turns and women's turns, no booking
bestFor: A small sauna in the old hospital park
flag: Open to the public only on the listed turns, so check the month's dates first. Pay at Café Lähde, or the sauna host when the café is shut.

name: Löylykontti Sörnäinen
priceLabel: €5–14 per person per hour, by time of day · whole sauna €29–129 / hour · booked and paid online
sauna: Two saunas on the seafront promenade, Meri and Suvi, 10 bathers each and sold by the hour; mixed, swimsuits required. Self-service: a door code comes by email and the stove heats itself for the booking
pool: The sea, all year, down heated steps from the terrace; an ice hole in winter
hours: By the booked hour; free times are in their calendar
bestFor: A booked hour by the sea
flag: Online booking only. The booked hour is sauna time, so arrive 15 minutes early to change. Bring a swimsuit, a towel and a water bottle.

name: Yrjönkadun uimahalli
priceLabel: €6 / 2h on the first floor (reduced €3.30) · second floor €20 / 2h (reduced €15) with a rest cabin, towel and bathrobe · extra hour €12 · towel hire €8
sauna: First floor: two electric saunas, 85°C and 75°C. Second floor, on its own ticket: a wood-heated sauna, a small steam sauna and an infrared sauna
pool: A 25 m pool at 27°C in a 1920s hall, 0.9–3.4 m deep; swimmers only
hours: Women: Mon 12:00–20:00 · Wed & Fri 06:30–20:00 · Sun 11:00–20:00 · Men: Tue & Thu 06:30–20:00 · Sat 07:00–20:00 · second floor from 13:00, shut on Mondays · swimming ends 20:30 · closed in summer
bestFor: A 1920s hall where swimsuits are optional
flag: Women and men bathe on different days: women Mon, Wed, Fri and Sun, men Tue, Thu and Sat. The second floor holds 40 and is often full; advance tickets for it are sold online only.

stove.note: Two electric saunas on the first floor; the second floor adds a wood-heated sauna, a steam sauna and an infrared one

name: Lonnan sauna
priceLabel: €23 / 2h · under 12 free · soap, shampoo and seat cover included · towel €9
sauna: A log building with two loft saunas, each heated by a large single-fired wood stove; mixed every day, with or without a swimsuit; 12 places open on each side every hour
pool: The sea, over a rocky shore; bring shoes for it
bestFor: A wood-fired sauna on a small island
flag: Seasonal: the island shuts for the winter. In season a waterbus runs from Kauppatori in about ten minutes, and booking the sauna ahead is strongly recommended.

stove.note: Two loft saunas, each with a large single-fired wood stove
